verses.text: Hallelu YAH! Praise the name of YHWH! Give praise, O servants of YHWH

segments.text: Hallelu YAH! Praise the name of YHWH! Give praise, O servants of YHWH

verses.text: who are standing in the house of YHWH, in the courts of the house of our God!

segments.text: who are standing in the house of YHWH, in the courts of the house of our God!

verses.text: Praise YAH, for YHWH [is] good; sing praises to His name, for [it is] pleasant!

segments.text: Praise YAH, for YHWH [is] good; sing praises to His name, for [it is] pleasant!

verses.text: For YAH has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His possession.

segments.text: For YAH has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His possession.

verses.text: For I know that YHWH [is] great, and our Lord is greater than all gods!

segments.text: For I know that YHWH [is] great, and our Lord is greater than all gods!

verses.text: All that YHWH delights in, He does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the depths,

segments.text: All that YHWH delights in, He does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the depths,

verses.text: bringing up the clouds from the ends of the earth. He has made lightning for the rain, bringing forth the wind from His storehouses—

segments.text: bringing up the clouds from the ends of the earth. He has made lightning for the rain, bringing forth the wind from His storehouses—

verses.text: who struck the firstborn of Egypt, from man even to beast.

segments.text: who struck the firstborn of Egypt, from man even to beast.

verses.text: He sent forth signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, unto Pharaoh and all of his servants—

segments.text: He sent forth signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, unto Pharaoh and all of his servants—

verses.text: who struck many nations and killed mighty kings,

segments.text: who struck many nations and killed mighty kings,

verses.text: even Sihon king of the Amorite, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

segments.text: even Sihon king of the Amorite, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

verses.text: And He gave their land [as] an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

segments.text: And He gave their land [as] an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

verses.text: O YHWH, Your name [is] forever; YHWH, Your memorial [is] to generation and generation!

segments.text: O YHWH, Your name [is] forever; YHWH, Your memorial [is] to generation and generation!

verses.text: For YHWH will vindicate His people, and He will have compassion on His servants.

segments.text: For YHWH will vindicate His people, and He will have compassion on His servants.

verses.text: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of the hands of man.

segments.text: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of the hands of man.

verses.text: Mouths [are] unto them, and they do not speak; eyes [are] unto them, and they do not see.

segments.text: Mouths [are] unto them, and they do not speak; eyes [are] unto them, and they do not see.

verses.text: Ears [are] unto them and they do not hear; indeed, there [is] no breath in their mouths.

segments.text: Ears [are] unto them and they do not hear; indeed, there [is] no breath in their mouths.

verses.text: Their makers shall come to be like them—everyone who is trusting in them!

segments.text: Their makers shall come to be like them—everyone who is trusting in them!

verses.text: O House of Israel, bless YHWH; O house of Aaron, bless YHWH;

segments.text: O House of Israel, bless YHWH; O house of Aaron, bless YHWH;

verses.text: O house of Levi, bless YHWH; [all you] fearing YHWH, bless YHWH!

segments.text: O house of Levi, bless YHWH; [all you] fearing YHWH, bless YHWH!

verses.text: Blessed be YHWH from Zion, the One dwelling [in] Jerusalem! Praise YAH!

segments.text: Blessed be YHWH from Zion, the One dwelling [in] Jerusalem! Praise YAH!
